name: SectionedForm
summary: A form in sections, as an inspector's or a settings page's: from `twoColumnFrom` of its own width, a list of the sections (titles, under their group headings) beside the chosen section's fields; narrower, every section in turn, one below the other. Each section is a PropertySection. Not for sections a person opens and closes (Accordion), for switching between unrelated panels (Tabs) or for a list beside a document (ListDetail).
a11y: In two columns the list is a named `nav` holding a single-select listbox (List): the chosen row is selected and its section is the only one shown. In one column the list is hidden and every section shows, each a `section` named by its heading. The column mode follows the form's own width, never the window's.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the form's list of sections, and heads the sections that have no `group`.

props.name: selected
props.description: The chosen section (controlled). Leave it out to let the form keep its own, starting at `defaultSelected` or the first.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: A section was chosen in the list.

props.name: twoColumnFrom
props.description: From this much of its own width, a CSS length in px, rem or em (default "40rem"), the list of sections sits beside the chosen one; narrower, every section shows in turn.

props.name: listWidth
props.description: The list's width in two columns, a CSS length (default the theme's `c.sectioned-form.list`, 13 rem).

props.name: details
props.description: Shows each section's `detail` as a second line in the list (default false: titles only).

props.name: density
props.description: Passed to each PropertySection: `compact` for a design tool's inspector.

props.name: mark
props.description: How the list shows the chosen section: `check` (default) a check over the fill; `fill` the fill alone (the section beside it already says which).

props.name: fill
props.description: LR104 (opt-in): the form fills its panel from top to bottom (an inspector): it takes the height its container gives it, the list of sections runs the full height beside the chosen one, and the chosen section's fields start at the top.

props.name: title
props.description: The section's name: its heading, and its row in the list.

props.name: group
props.description: The list heading it sits under ("Questions"); sections without one sit under the form's `label`.

props.name: detail
props.description: One short line about the section. Not drawn unless `details` is set.
